title: GUVI: Circle Metrics (Area & Circumference)
description: Given the radius `r` of a circle, calculate its area and circumference using pi = 3.14159. Return a list `[area, circumference]` with both values rounded to 2 decimal places.
solution:
def circle_metrics(r: float) -> list[float]:
    PI = 3.141592653589793
    area = round(PI * r * r, 2)
    circ = round(2 * PI * r, 2)
    return [area, circ]
explanation: Calculates circle dimensions in O(1) time.
